name: agenticros-skill-roboparts
description: RoboParts compatibility registry — 865 robot component entities, 20 categories, 4D compatibility check (protocol/electrical/mechanical/software). Vendor-neutral: we neither manufacture nor resell any part.

scripts.build: node --check index.js && node --check lib/mcp-client.js && echo "Build OK"

author: RoboParts (https://roboparts.cc)

agenticros.description: Vendor-neutral robot parts compatibility registry — 865 entities across 20 categories, 4D compatibility checks (protocol/electrical/mechanical/software), BOM validation, URDF linting, and multi-agent review.

capabilities.description: Search 865 robot component entities by keyword and/or category across 20 categories (actuators, sensors, chips, platforms, grippers, etc.).
Get full detail of a single component by ID, including source tier, confidence, mechanical interface, standard conformance, and data quality.
Check 4D compatibility (protocol / electrical / mechanical / software-ROS2) between two components. Returns per-dimension verdicts with evidence and uncertainty flags.
Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 components on key parameters (torque, speed, voltage, protocol, interface, weight, price).
Recommend component candidates for an application scenario (humanoid, quadruped, robot_arm, amr, industrial) with optional budget filter.
Retrieve parameter semantic definitions — same field (e.g. torque, speed) can mean different things across vendors (19 torque variants, 37 speed variants).
Pairwise compatibility matrix for a BOM (bill of materials). Input component IDs, get every pair's protocol/electrical/mechanical/software verdict.
Natural-language semantic search over component entities using offline TF-IDF vector index (zero external model, zero data exfiltration).
Standard conformance audit — cross-validate entity declarations against known ISO/ANSI standards registry. Returns coverage, gaps, and conflicts.
Multi-agent quality-assurance review of compatibility between two parts. Worker layer executes 4D verdict; Governor layer independently reviews for correctness and data quality.
Static compatibility check of URDF XML — validates 10 categories of issues (missing links, invalid joints, duplicate names, missing inertials, etc.).
